mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_USER (ID, NAME, PASSWORD, PASSWORD_SALT, EMAIL, PHONE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, POSTCODE, ACCOUNT_TYPE, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, GUARDIAN_NAME, GUARDIAN_PHONE) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{password}, #{passwordSalt}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{postcode}, #{accountType}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{guardianName}, #{guardianPhone})
mapper.update:
UPDATE T_USER
NAME = #{name}, PHONE = #{phone}, BIRTH_DATE = #{birthDate}, GENDER = #{gender}, GUARDIAN_NAME = #{guardianName}, GUARDIAN_PHONE = #{guardianPhone},
WHERE ID = #{id} AND ACCOUNT_TYPE = 'CHILD'
mapper.select: SELECT ID, NAME, ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM T_USER WHERE ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') -- OR NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ORDER BY ID LIMIT 20
